1) The core TICT claim is only weakly supported by direct torsional evidence: the excited-state torsion trend is essentially flat/none (E31; abs delta_dihedral 0.043°), and the combined structural relaxation proxy is low (E37), which undermines a “twist-to-CT minimum” narrative.
2) The argument leans heavily on neighbor similarity/label transfer (top1_sim 0.94; neighbors mostly TICT) but does not clearly separate “shared scaffold” from “shared mechanism”; the label-stratified aTB comparison shows the target’s abs_delta_dihedral is actually closest to the ICT group (E23), not TICT.
3) Electronic “CT-ness” is ambiguous: redistribution_score is “medium” (E36) and redistribution magnitude “mid” (E35), but the permanent dipole change across S0→S1 is near zero (E62), which weakens an ICT/TICT interpretation if dipole change is expected to correlate.
4) There is an internal bucket mismatch for gap/redistribution: self-only aTB trend marks delta_gap bucket “low” (E32) while the charge redistribution profile calls delta_gap_bucket “mid” (E36). The narrative should explain why these differ (different calibration/thresholding) rather than treating them as consistent.
5) The emission evidence only anchors an aggregate emission wavelength (E70) with aggr_only coverage (E72) and medium reliability (E73); inferring “AIE via suppression of a nonradiative channel” is speculative without solution/dilute data.
6) The supporting_chain cites mismatched evidence IDs (e.g., torsion_access step A cites E70; ct_family step B cites E72; aIE_bridge step C cites E31). This misalignment makes the traceability of claims to evidence unreliable even if the underlying idea is reasonable.
7) The compact-prior neighbor majority label being ESIPT (E57) is treated as disfavoring ESIPT, but the same pack explicitly indicates “no tautomerizable proton-transfer site” (compact_prior_metrics_v1) and says compact neighbor reliability is low (E57). This needs clearer adjudication: “majority ESIPT” is likely an artifact of coarse compact metrics, not a meaningful ESIPT signal.
